description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource class for interoperation functionalities within the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints for health checks, account details, transaction queries, identifier management, transaction requests, quotes, transfers, KYC, loan disbursement, and loan repayment operations. The class integrates with services like InteropService and command sourcing, and uses annotations for Swagger documentation, JAX-RS HTTP method mappings, and dependency injection.

classes.name: InteropApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing interoperation API endpoints for account info, transactions, identifiers, quotes, transfers, KYC, and loans within Apache Fineract.

methods.name: getAccountDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of an interoperation account given an account ID.

methods.name: getAccountTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transactions for a specified account, filtered by debit/credit status and booking date range.

methods.name: getAccountIdentifiers
methods.description: Fetches secondary identifiers associated with an account.

methods.name: getAccountByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves account info based on a secondary identifier, optionally by sub-identifier.

methods.name: registerAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Registers a new secondary identifier for an account.

methods.name: deleteAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Deletes a secondary identifier from an account.

methods.name: getTransactionRequest
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific transaction request by transaction and request codes.

methods.name: createTransactionRequest
methods.description: Creates a new transaction request, likely based on a JSON payload.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Retrieves a quote for a specific transaction and quote code.

methods.name: createQuote
methods.description: Calculates and creates a new quote for a transaction.

methods.name: getTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves details of a transfer associated with a transaction.

methods.name: performTransfer
methods.description: Performs a transfer action, with validation for the 'action' parameter.

methods.name: getClientKyc
methods.description: Fetches KYC data for an account.

methods.name: disburseLoan
methods.description: Disburses a loan to an account, with JSON request payload.

methods.name: loanReypaymanet
methods.description: Handles loan repayment for an account, with JSON request payload.
